content:
On July 6, 2026, Optimism focused on critical infrastructure stability and ecosystem development, including mitigating a gas limit bug on OP Mainnet and resolving a memory leak in `op-reth`. Significant progress was also made in refining testing processes and updating core contracts for post-U19 network states, alongside routine updates to the Superchain registry.

## ✅ Completed Work
### OP Stack Stability & Infrastructure
- **OP Mainnet Gas Limit Mitigation**: A critical gas limit bug affecting Karst (U19) on OP Mainnet was mitigated by resetting the L2 block gas limit to correct an approximately 55 MGas discrepancy in `ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops` ([#1480](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1480)).
- **`op-reth` Memory Leak Resolution**: A critical memory leak in `op-reth` was addressed, ensuring Prometheus metric buckets are properly drained during `op-proofs` CLI backfills to prevent unbounded RSS growth in `ethereum-optimism/optimism` ([#21596](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21596)).
- **Enhanced Testing Infrastructure**: Scheduled tests were moved from weekly to daily cadence for more frequent feedback, and a new script was introduced to validate CircleCI schedule triggers in `ethereum-optimism/optimism` ([#21595](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21595), [#21575](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21575)).

### Superchain Ecosystem Development
- **Superchain Registry Update**: An automated code generation update modified the `addresses.json` file within the `superchain/extra` directory, keeping the registry current in `ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry` ([#1277](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/1277)).
- **Karst on Osaka L2s Enabled**: The issue concerning the enablement of Karst on Osaka L2s was closed in `ethereum-optimism/op-geth` ([#747](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/747)), indicating progress in the Superchain ecosystem.
- **Contracts Bedrock Updates for U19**: The `contracts-bedrock` package was updated to correctly handle the disabled Cannon fork state following the U19 upgrade, including adjustments to the fork test harness in `ethereum-optimism/optimism` ([#21621](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21621)).

### Core Geth Enhancements
- **Transaction Pool and Downloader Improvements**: Improvements were made to batch interop checks in the transaction pool for more efficient RPC calls and error messages in the downloader were embellished for more informative details in `ethereum-optimism/op-geth` ([#633](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/633), [#722](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/722)).
